output.summary: Evergreen climbing shrub native to Central and northwestern South America, sweet granadilla climbs surrounding vegetation using coiling tendrils. Its aromatic, sweet-musky flowers last only one day. Ripe yellowish-orange fruits contain hard black seeds surrounded by translucent, sweet, edible pulp.
output.edibilityNote: The translucent pulp surrounding the hard black seeds is the edible part of the ripe fruit and tastes sweet.
